summary: Ares Sports, Media and Entertainment Opportunities LP filed Form 8-K reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership units under Items 3.02 and 8.01. On July 1, 2026, the Fund sold 5,319 Class S, 123,454 Class I, 596,252 Class A-S, and 337,721 Class A-I units for aggregate consideration of approximately $30.1 million, with the number finalized on July 21, 2026 based on June 30, 2026 transactional NAVs. Sales were made to accredited investors and qualified purchasers under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D exemptions, including through a feeder vehicle for certain tax-exempt and non-U.S. investors. This is a routine capital raise in a continuous offering, not a special situation.
